scope_read: data/worklists/f2-task.md, f3-task.md (definition of the rotation receipt's setup/consume edge taxonomy)

leaf_semantics_as_reconstructed.statement: 'rotation' is the derived optimal-event-order receipt; 'consume' is the ordered list of ability slots detected as the CONSUME side of a setup/consume edge (the abilities that spend or are enhanced by a state another ability applies).
leaf_semantics_as_reconstructed.source_quote: data/worklists/f3-task.md, deliverable 1a: "DETECT setup/consume edges automatically from the ability rows + module metadata: an ability whose row names indicate application (poison/blemish/stack/mark/amp/slow/root/stun/on-hit) must precede abilities that consume (enhanced/consume/detonate/bonus-vs/X-stack/%missing)"
leaf_semantics_as_reconstructed.supporting_quote: data/worklists/f2-task.md: "the fight should cast the OPTIMAL rotation (apply-before-consume, reapply buffs/poisons, detonate stacks at the right moment)" and "The /api/calculate response gains a 'rotation' receipt: {order: [Q,E,E,E,...], rationale: \"Q poisons, E consumes\"}"
leaf_semantics_as_reconstructed.scenario_name: '_120' = the Splinters of Wrath option pinned at the cap of 120, so every Transcendent threshold (40/60/80/100/120) is active in this scenario.

step_1_enumerate_syndras_state_producer.claim: Q Dark Sphere is the APPLY (setup) side: it creates the persistent world state the rest of the kit reads.
step_1_enumerate_syndras_state_producer.wiki_quote: data/champions.json Syndra Q: "Active: Syndra conjures a Dark Sphere at the target location that appears after a 0.6-second delay, dealing magic damage to nearby enemies. The Dark Sphere then remains on the ground for 6 seconds."
step_1_enumerate_syndras_state_producer.note: Q's own Transcendent bonus (40 splinters) is an AMMO/charge mechanic ('periodically stock a Dark Sphere charge, up to a maximum of 2'), classified in data/wiki-atoms/stack-transform-summon-resource.json as 'Ammo / stocked charges', not as a setup/consume edge between abilities. Q is therefore the setup side, not a consumer.

step_2_enumerate_consumers.wiki_quote: "Active: Syndra telekinetically grabs the nearest Dark Sphere, enemy minion or non-epic monster within 500 units from the target location... Recast: Syndra throws the grabbed target towards the target location... dealing magic damage"
step_2_enumerate_consumers.enhanced_at_120: "Transcendent Bonus: Collecting 60 Splinters of Wrath enhances Force of Will to deal 12% (+ 2% per 100 AP) bonus true damage." — cached row 'Bonus True Damage' / 'Total Mixed Damage' present in data/champions.json, i.e. the 'enhanced' keyword AND a numeric row.

step_2_enumerate_consumers.consumes: a live Dark Sphere (knocked-back sphere carries the stun and the damage)
step_2_enumerate_consumers.wiki_quote: "Dark Spheres can be knocked back for 950 units and up to 1200 units away from Syndra based on proximity, knocking back enemies they hit over 70 units... Targets hit are also stunned for 1.25 seconds, during which they are also revealed, and dealt Scatter the Weak's damage if they were not damaged by the initial cast."
step_2_enumerate_consumers.enhanced_at_120: "Transcendent Bonus: Collecting 80 Splinters of Wrath enhances Scatter the Weak to have an increased scatter angle and slow enemies hit by 70%..."

step_2_enumerate_consumers.consumes: up to 4 pre-existing live Dark Spheres, and its damage is a strict function of how many it collects
step_2_enumerate_consumers.wiki_quote: "Active: Syndra conjures 3 Dark Spheres and additionally grabs up to 4 nearby live ones. Afterwards, she barrages the target enemy champion with all collected Dark Spheres, each dealing magic damage upon hit."
step_2_enumerate_consumers.enhanced_at_120: "Transcendent Bonus: Collecting 100 Splinters of Wrath enhances Unleashed Power to execute the target if it would damage them to below 15% of their maximum health." — 'enhances' + a % maximum-health execute, two of the spec's consume markers.

numeric_proof_that_R_reads_the_sphere_po.arithmetic: min/per = 240/80 = 360/120 = 480/160 = 3.0 and 60%AP / 20%AP = 3.0  ->  3 spheres (the ones R conjures itself). max/per = 560/80 = 840/120 = 1120/160 = 7.0 and 140%AP / 20%AP = 7.0  ->  7 spheres = 3 conjured + 4 grabbed live ones.
numeric_proof_that_R_reads_the_sphere_po.conclusion: R's damage range 3x..7x per-sphere is generated ENTIRELY by consuming 0..4 spheres that Q (or a prior R) left on the ground. That is a load-bearing, numerically sourced setup(Q) -> consume(R) edge, not a cosmetic one.

step_3_order_and_index.ordering: Both candidate orderings agree: (a) canonical slot order Q,W,E,R -> consumers W,E,R; (b) Transcendent threshold order 60,80,100 -> W,E,R; (c) any cast order (R is single-cast and terminal per docs/math-foundations.md row 'Ability rotation casts ... R single-cast') -> R last.
step_3_order_and_index.consistency_with_the_old_state: The old leaf was ABSENT at index 2, i.e. the old list had exactly 2 entries. That is consistent with a prior [W, E] gaining R, and inconsistent with any Q-inclusive list [Q,W,E,...] (which would already have had index 2 = 'E'). So the change is an append of the previously-missed R consumer, and index 2 = R.

step_4_could_R_be_wrongly_included.counter_argument_considered: R leaves spheres behind ("The Dark Spheres will then remain on the ground next to the target's current location for 6 seconds"), so one could argue R does not destroy the pool.
step_4_could_R_be_wrongly_included.why_it_fails: The consume side of the taxonomy is 'reads/spends an applied state to gain a bonus', not 'annihilates it'. R's Minimum/Maximum rows prove the collected spheres are consumed AS DAMAGE INPUT (3x -> 7x per-sphere), and at 120 splinters R additionally carries the 'enhances ... execute ... 15% of their maximum health' row, which matches the spec's consume markers ('enhanced', '% ... maximum health') directly. Excluding R would leave the single most sphere-dependent ability in the kit off the consumer list.

docs/math-foundations.md, Section 5 table row 'Ability rotation casts (_schedule_shared_casts, _compute_ability_rotation) ... R single-cast'
conclusion: At 120 Splinters of Wrath, Syndra's consume-side abilities are W (grabs/throws a live Dark Sphere; 60-splinter enhanced true damage), E (knocked-back Dark Sphere carries the stun and damage; 80-splinter enhancement), and R (grabs up to 4 live spheres, damage 3x..7x per-sphere; 100-splinter enhanced execute). The third consumer is R, so consume[2] = "R"; its previous absence omitted the kit's most sphere-dependent ability.
